retrievalProfile.description: A centered square painting of a dog surrounded by bubbles, set against a vast black field with tactile, glitter-encrusted hand-lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured composition featuring a central square oil-style painting of a Doberman-like dog with its mouth open, surrounded by iridescent bubbles. The painting is framed by a solid black background. Above and below the image, text is rendered in a thick, 3D-effect silver material that appears to be dusted with gold glitter and stardust particles.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square image floating in a black void
Textured, tactile typography mirroring the sparkle of the bubbles
High contrast between the colorful inset and the dark surrounding space
Symmetrical vertical alignment of text and image
coreInvariants: Square aspect ratio for the central artwork
Glitter/sparkle texture applied to the lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A square painting occupies the center 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dog's open mouth and the surrounding colorful bubbles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical flow from the top header text, down to the central image, and finally to the bottom footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central elements, creating a 'void' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Silver and gold glitter for text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Iridescent pastels (pink, blue, yellow) in the bubbles
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text/painting and the zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, irregular strokes suggesting hand-molded clay or heavy paint
Surrounded by a halo of fine glitter particles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Parentheses used to enclose specific words in the bottom line
Slightly uneven baseline for a DIY feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom lettering style used for all text elements to maintain material consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base skeleton for the thick, molded lettering.
Matches the soft, rounded aesthetic of the bubbles in the art.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square canvas. In the center, place a square oil painting of a Doberman dog with its mouth open, surrounded by many colorful, iridescent soap bubbles against a pale yellow and blue painterly background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in all-caps at the top and bottom. The text should have a thick, 3D silver metallic appearance with a heavy dusting of gold glitter particles around the edges of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a perfect square?
Does the text have a tactile, glittery texture?
Are the bubbles iridescent and translucent?

mustAchieve: Painterly texture in the central inset

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the glitter effect doesn't obscure the legibility of the text.
Check that the central square is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the 3D depth of the letters looks consistent.
Confirm the dog's expression is energetic and matches the bubble theme.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Square Art + Black Void + Glitter Embossed Typography
